source.title: How Uber Evals 1 Million Agent Skill Invocations a Month
source.authority: User-supplied reference evidence; not authorization or a format standard

planning_assessment.create: Generate observable required/forbidden/order contracts for subject cases.
planning_assessment.audit: Assess subject trajectories independently of answer quality and activation.
planning_assessment.verification: Known ordered, reordered, forbidden and incomplete traces on separate subjects.

planning_assessment.create: Derive subject cases from redacted real failures with annotation and held-out ownership.
planning_assessment.audit: Inspect provenance, oracle and environment isolation; missing trials remain unrun.
planning_assessment.verification: Broader incident-derived corpus preparation and runtime-only subject integration; no native benefit inferred.

planning_assessment.create: Freeze named instruction variants and blind matched artifact comparisons before pruning.
planning_assessment.audit: Check variant identity, grading blindness, identical-condition variation and retained negative results.
planning_assessment.verification: Variant schedules, blinded files, complete/incomplete judgments, identical-payload comparisons and unsafe-run accounting.

planning_assessment.create: Emit an opt-in local incident worksheet linked to a regression case and owning layer.
planning_assessment.audit: Assess redaction, reproduction, ownership and evidence before closure.
planning_assessment.verification: Open/closed incident validation, missing regression evidence and target nonexecution.

planning_assessment.create: Emit stable requirements linking source hashes to case/check IDs.
planning_assessment.audit: Detect drift and untested or incorrectly mapped forbidden actions without trusting target instructions.
planning_assessment.verification: Valid mapping, changed source, unknown check, duplicate requirement and escaped owner rejection.

planning_assessment.create: Review completion conditions, command checks and actionable recovery before delivery.
planning_assessment.audit: Use bounded diagnostics as review locators rather than semantic verdicts.
planning_assessment.verification: Useful and deliberately flawed subject procedures; diagnostics never certify semantic quality.

shared_propagation.helper_outputs: Both helpers receive the same visibly unfinished new companion worksheets.
shared_propagation.host_adapters: Document normalized observable events and isolation limits; no permissions, tools or install paths change.
shared_propagation.packaging: Existing runtime selection includes new scripts, references and assets; verify a runtime-only copy and release tests.
shared_propagation.delivery_review: Record actual checks and remaining claims in a new append-only docs/change-impact record.

adaptation_limits: No automatic reporting, telemetry, marketplace, installer, paid-model runner or model-specific compiler.
Uber's ratios, pass rates, savings and MCP policies are context-specific observations, not acceptance thresholds.
No source archive, original rule, template or historical receipt is rewritten.
